That was largely thanks to Bo Bichette , who drove home nine runs in the series, including both of New York’s runs in Thursday’s 2-1 win over the Nats .

lastMeeting.recapHeadline: How to make up for an error? Homer during your pitcher's in-game interview
recapNotes: NEW YORK – “Oh, nice!” While Marlins right-hander Janson Junk discussed his outing during an in-game interview, including a treacherous fifth inning in which Kyle Stowers ’ fielding error led to an unearned run, Stowers atoned for his miscue with a solo homer.

When Stowers returned to the dugout, where he held up the club’s Miami nightclub-inspired bottle service sign and made his way through a row of teammates, Junk was there to greet him in Friday night’s 5-2 victory over the Mets at Citi Field.

But he still managed to leave the game after six innings with a lead the Dodgers ultimately held on to for a 4-3 win .
